subject: Re: Marketplace PoC, SOW draft and metering split
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@stratusintl.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 23 Aug 2029 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace PoC + co-sell / metering question

Hi Naomi —

Thanks again for the intro earlier this week. Stratus International is keen to run a short PoC with Redwood to validate listing in our AWS Marketplace catalog and how co-sell revenue attribution would work. Two asks to start:

1) Can you share a short SOW we can review that covers a 4-week PoC (objectives: listing readiness, entitlement mapping, and a joint demo)?
2) We need a proposed metering/rev split for marketplace usage during the pilot and the production rollout (this will feed procurement + our finance team).

Happy to loop in our procurement contacts if you prefer — copying Sara from CloudBridge (our integrator) to keep them in the loop.

Target window: early Sept for a kickoff.

Cheers,
Liam
Liam O'Connor

Thanks, excited to partner on this. Quick responses:
- We'll produce a short SOW for a 4-week PoC. Ben (partnerships) will own the SOW and commercials.
- Vivek (cc-ed on the follow up) will outline recommended metering splits and the technical options for entitlement during the pilot.
- Connor will confirm the technical checklist for listing readiness (VPC, private offers, test SKUs).

Ben / Connor — can you please draft a SOW + metering proposal? We should include: kickoff week (first week of Sept), success criteria (demo, 1 marketplace listing validated, entitlement end‑to‑end), and a single point of contact for procurement.

I can host the kickoff meeting — propose Sept 9 or 10 (10:00 PT).

Naomi

Hi Liam / Naomi —

Attaching a first-pass SOW for the 4-week PoC (Stratus_PoC_SOW_v1.docx). High-level callouts inside the doc:
- Scope: listing readiness (AWS Marketplace), entitlement mapping to Stratus customers, joint demo and a short findings doc.
- Timeline: prep week + 3 weeks of PoC activity; kickoff week of Sept 9 (flexible).
- Deliverables: SOW + test SKUs + runbook + go/no-go checklist.
- Commercials: pilot pricing is set as a cost-recovery credit; production metering split to be agreed before GA.

To expedite procurement, can you provide the Stratus billing/legal contact so we can get a PO or Private Offer template ready?

Proposed calendar: Kickoff (60m) Sept 9, 10:00 PT. If that works I will send a meeting invite with an agenda.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Attachment: Stratus_PoC_SOW_v1.docx

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@stratusintl.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Aug 2029 14:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace PoC + co-sell / metering question

Liam —

Couple of technical notes that should be included in the runbook / prep:
- Private offers / PrivateLink: confirm whether Stratus will use Private Offers or public listing for the pilot. Private Offer simplifies entitlement testing but we can do both.
- VPC peering & VPC endpoints: we'll need temporary test credentials and an example tenant for catalog verification.
- Test SKUs: we will create a non-billable SKU for validation before enabling real metering.
- Telemetry: please share any telemetry events Stratus needs tagged for attribution (user_id, org_id, purchase_order_id).

Checklist link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B-example — I'll drop a template runbook there.

On the kickoff call I'll walk through the listing checklist and the test SKU lifecycle.

Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@stratusintl.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Aug 2029 09:55:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace PoC + co-sell / metering question

Liam / Ben —

I've attached a proposed metering and revenue attribution spreadsheet (redwood_metering_proposal.xlsx) with two options:

Option A — Marketplace-managed metering: AWS Marketplace reports usage to Stratus; revenue share settled via the marketplace (standard approach). Pros: simpler billing flow. Cons: Stratus gives up some direct billing control.

Option B — Direct metering with pass-through: Redwood reports usage and invoices Stratus; Stratus invoices the end customer. Pros: tighter controls and gross/net preferences for Stratus finance. Cons: more integration work for PO/entitlement mapping.

For the pilot I recommend Option A with a 70/30 split (70% Stratus / 30% Redwood) to reflect Stratus-led sales and marketing investment. If procurement prefers direct invoicing, Option B is feasible but will add ~2 weeks of configuration for entitlement reconciliation.

Ben — please confirm whether the pilot pricing (cost-recovery credit) in the SOW is acceptable and we'll lock the split in the final SOW.

Vivek
Director, Revenue Partnerships | Redwood Inference

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@stratusintl.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: contracts@stratusintl.com, Sara Patel <sara.patel@cloudbridge.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Aug 2029 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace PoC + co-sell / metering question

Thanks team — this looks good. A few quick items: 

- We reviewed the SOW and are OK with the scope. We have requested a PO from our procurement team (cc-ed contracts@stratusintl.com).
- We accept Option A (Marketplace-managed metering) for the pilot and the 70/30 split. Please reflect that in the final SOW.
- DocuSign: I just completed signing the initial agreement — attaching the receipt (signed_docu_sign_receipt.pdf).

Kickoff confirmed for Sept 9, 10:00 PT. Sara from CloudBridge will join to coordinate integration.

Looking forward to it — Liam
